title: RDM Maturity Model
description: Shape of _data/maturity_model.json. Relational rules that compare one field with another (for example that weights and maturityLevels are the same length) cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and live in scripts/validate_model.py instead.

cleanString.description: Human-readable text: no leading or trailing whitespace, no line breaks or tabs.

weight.description: Score contribution of one maturity level, as a string between "0" and "1". Strings rather than numbers is the current convention, shared with the DSW knowledge model export. Weights live in the indicator's parallel `weights` array, not on the level itself.

maturityLevel.description: One level of one indicator. Levels became objects in model 2.0.0; before that they were plain title strings.

levelId.description: Stable identifier, formed as the indicatorId followed by the level's order: mm-support-network-2. Referenced by anything that needs to point at a single level, so it outlives rewording of the title.

order.description: Position of the level within the indicator, starting at 1 and rising by one. Matches the level's index in maturityLevels and in weights.

title.description: Short name of the level, used as the heading on the handbook page and in the overview table.

briefDescription.description: The part of the level's longer wording that says more than the title, with the repeated title stripped off the front, so a renderer can show the title alone or the two together. Present only where a longer wording exists, so most levels do not carry it.

impact.description: What sitting at this level means in practice for the organisation and its researchers.

criteria.description: What this level looks like in practice, one named facet per entry. Markdown, conventionally "**Label:** sentence", rendered as a bullet list under the level heading.

versionNumber.description: Semantic version of the model, bumped on every release.

domains.description: The areas the model is divided into. Referenced by name from each indicator.

indicators.description: One entry per indicator. indicatorId is the stable identifier: the DS Handbook uses it as the page_id of the matching indicator page.

domain.description: Must match the domainName of one entry in domains.

indicatorId.description: Stable identifier, also the page_id of the handbook page for this indicator.

indicatorLevel.description: Position in the model as domain.indicator, for example 3.2. The part before the dot must equal domainLevel.

indicatorBriefDescription.description: The part of the indicator's longer name that says more than `indicator` itself, kept where the short name would otherwise lose scope. Present on only a couple of indicators.

indicatorDescription.description: One or two sentences on what the indicator measures. Reused verbatim as the description of the handbook page.

indicatorLongDescription.description: The paragraph that opens the indicator page: what the indicator assesses, what it looks at, and what rising maturity means for it. Longer than indicatorDescription, which stays the one-line summary.

maturityLevels.description: The levels of this indicator, lowest first. Three to five levels; five only where a fifth is genuinely needed.

weights.description: Score for each maturity level, in the same order and the same number as maturityLevels.
